description: Send Balcones Apiary Co. a requirement (Managed hive placement and agricultural valuation support). A successful submission is recorded with a reference number. When an address is left, Balcones Apiary Co. replies by email. Balcones evaluates district rules, eligible area, history and site needs, seeks placement options and prepares feasibility, a management and documentation scope and proposed written terms. Nothing is ordered or committed until the owner agrees terms. Contact details are kept apart from the requirement, while we correspond or do business and for 24 months after, so a later request picks up where it left off; ask us to delete them at any time. It is answered with a receipt: keep its id and token to read its status (request_status), to add details later (continuation) and to act on an offer made in reply. A requirement is not an order and costs nothing.
